metadata.title: Zephyr Protocol Security Audit Checklist - Batch 4
metadata.description: Partial checklist covering properties PROP-061 through PROP-081 (excluding boundary edges already covered in Stage 1)

checklist.title: Job Failure State Transition Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that STATE-JOB-FAILED is only reached when IVC verification or Groth16 generation actually fails, and that valid proofs cannot be incorrectly marked as failed.
steps: Review the Decider/Prover service code for job state management
Identify all code paths that transition to JOB-FAILED state
Verify each failure path corresponds to a genuine error condition
Check for race conditions that could mark valid jobs as failed
Verify failed state is terminal and cannot transition to completed

executable_checks.focus: Ensure failure transitions only occur on genuine errors
Verify test coverage for error handling paths

checklist.notes: Terminal failure state - ensure no valid proofs are incorrectly rejected

checklist.title: Adaptor Contract State Management

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the Adaptor contract correctly manages its idle state and does not process requests while in an invalid state.
steps: Review Adaptor contract initialization and state variables
Verify no complex state machine exists beyond function execution
Check for reentrancy guards that could affect state
Ensure contract cannot be stuck in non-idle state

executable_checks.focus: Review state management and entry points
Check for state variable manipulation issues

checklist.notes: Entry point for bridge operations - simple state model expected

checklist.title: Bridge Request Input Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE properly validates user balance and bridge parameters before processing.
steps: Locate the unwrap-and-bridge entry function in Adaptor
Verify zERC20 balance is checked before proceeding
Validate bridge destination parameters are verified
Check for proper error messages on validation failure
Verify Stargate parameter validation prevents invalid destinations

executable_checks.focus: Test with invalid balances and destination parameters

checklist.notes: Entry validation is critical - insufficient balance or invalid params must revert

checklist.title: zERC20 Burn Before Bridge Ordering

detection_procedure.description: Verify that zERC20 tokens are burned via LiquidityManager BEFORE any bridging of underlying occurs, preventing double-spend scenarios.
steps: Trace the unwrap-and-bridge execution flow
Verify LiquidityManager.unwrap() is called first
Confirm underlying tokens are only available after burn
Check for reentrancy that could bypass ordering
Verify atomicity of the burn operation

executable_checks.focus: Check for reentrancy and ordering issues

checklist.notes: Critical ordering - unwrap must complete before bridge to prevent unbacked bridging

checklist.title: Stargate Bridge Slippage Protection

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the Stargate bridge call includes proper slippage protection via minAmountOut parameter.
steps: Locate the Stargate.send() call in Adaptor
Verify minAmountOut parameter is properly set
Check if user can specify their own slippage tolerance
Verify reasonable default slippage if user doesn't specify
Check for front-running protection on slippage parameters

executable_checks.description: Test bridge with various minAmountOut values
executable_checks.focus: Verify Stargate reverts when slippage exceeded

checklist.notes: Slippage protection is user-configurable - verify defaults are safe

checklist.title: Bridge Initiation Event Emission

detection_procedure.description: Verify that STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED is only reached after successful Stargate message sending and that UnwrapAndBridge event is emitted atomically.
steps: Locate UnwrapAndBridge event definition and emission
Verify event is emitted only after Stargate.send() success
Check event parameters match actual bridge details
Verify event emission is atomic with state transition
Check for missing event emissions on edge cases

executable_checks.focus: Event emission timing and data accuracy

checklist.notes: Terminal success state - event is the primary observable outcome

checklist.title: Bridge Failure Fund Recovery

detection_procedure.description: Verify that if Stargate bridge fails after zERC20 unwrap, user funds are not lost. Refund mechanism must return underlying tokens.
steps: Identify failure scenarios after unwrap but before bridge completion
Trace fund flow when Stargate.send() reverts
Verify refund mechanism exists and works correctly
Check for stuck funds scenarios
Verify user can recover funds in all failure paths

executable_checks.focus: Error handling and fund recovery paths
Verify no fund loss in failure scenarios

checklist.notes: CRITICAL: Potential fund loss scenario - error handling must be bulletproof

checklist.title: Stealth Address Generation Security

detection_procedure.description: Verify that stealth burn address generation is cryptographically secure - not predictable or reversible without secret knowledge.
steps: Review stealth address derivation algorithm
Verify keccak256 usage for randomness
Check Baby JubJub (BN254) operations for correctness
Verify PoW component adds sufficient entropy
Ensure secret is never exposed during generation

executable_checks.focus: Verify discrete log hardness and preimage resistance

checklist.notes: Privacy depends on secret confidentiality and crypto hardness assumptions

checklist.title: Nova IVC Proof Generation Soundness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that Nova IVC proof generation requires valid Merkle proofs and secrets - proof forgery without token ownership must be impossible.
steps: Review Nova circuit constraints for ownership proof
Verify Merkle path validation in circuit
Check secret/witness handling in proof generation
Verify public inputs are correctly bound
Test that invalid inputs fail proof generation

executable_checks.description: Formal verification of Nova circuit constraints
executable_checks.focus: Soundness - no proof without valid witness

checklist.notes: ZK soundness is critical - client-side proof generation

checklist.title: Local IVC Proof Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that local proof generation includes a verification step, ensuring invalid proofs fail before user proceeds to conversion.
steps: Review proof generation workflow in SDK
Verify local verification is called after generation
Check verification uses correct parameters
Ensure verification failure prevents proceeding
Test with deliberately corrupted proofs

executable_checks.focus: Local verification step presence and correctness
Verify rejection of malformed proofs locally

checklist.notes: Early validation catches errors before expensive conversion

checklist.title: IVC Proof Privacy Preservation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the IVC proof submission to the Decider/Prover service does not expose private information beyond what's necessary for conversion.
steps: Review what data is included in IVC proof submission
Verify private witness is NOT included
Check only public inputs and commitments are sent
Verify base64 encoding doesn't include extra data
Review API endpoint security

executable_checks.description: Capture and analyze proof submission payload

checklist.notes: Zero-knowledge property must be preserved during conversion

checklist.title: Retrieved Groth16 Proof Validity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the retrieved Groth16 proof will pass on-chain verification and that local pre-verification is possible.
steps: Review proof retrieval from Prover service
Verify proof format matches on-chain verifier expectations
Check if local verification is performed before submission
Verify correct circuit and verification key are used
Test with proofs from different circuit versions

executable_checks.focus: Verify Groth16 proofs pass on-chain verification

checklist.notes: Pre-submission verification prevents wasted gas on invalid proofs

checklist.title: Teleport Front-Running Protection

detection_procedure.description: Verify that teleport submission cannot be front-run - the proof must commit to a specific recipient (msg.sender) to prevent fund theft.
steps: Review Groth16 proof public inputs structure
Verify recipient is bound in proof commitment
Check on-chain verifier validates recipient binding
Test that changing recipient invalidates proof
Verify msg.sender is used as recipient on-chain

executable_checks.description: Attempt to front-run teleport with different recipient
executable_checks.focus: Verify proof fails for non-original recipient

checklist.notes: Critical: Front-running protection via recipient commitment

checklist.title: Verifier Rotation Access Control

detection_procedure.description: Verify that verifier address rotation is restricted to owner only via onlyOwner modifier.
steps: Locate setVerifiers() or equivalent function
Verify onlyOwner modifier is applied
Check for other access control mechanisms
Verify no proxy bypass of access control
Review owner key management (multisig recommended)

checklist.notes: Admin key security is external dependency - document assumptions

checklist.title: Emergency Deactivation Safety

detection_procedure.description: Verify that emergency deactivation is properly gated and understand the trust assumptions around owner's ability to restore normal operation.
steps: Locate emergency deactivation function
Verify access control (owner only)
Document what state is restored on deactivation
Review any timelock or multi-sig requirements
Understand trust assumptions for owner behavior

executable_checks.description: Review emergency procedures and trust assumptions
executable_checks.focus: Document accepted risks in owner trust

checklist.notes: Accepted risk - owner must verify safety before deactivation

checklist.title: Emergency Recovery State Integrity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that recovery from emergency state properly restores system to a valid, non-compromised state.
steps: Review recovery state transition logic
Verify all state variables are properly reset
Check for residual emergency state artifacts
Verify normal operations resume correctly
Document off-chain governance requirements

executable_checks.description: Test emergency -> recovery -> normal operation flow

checklist.notes: Recovery correctness depends on off-chain governance - document process

checklist.title: Reward Calculation Atomicity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the reward calculation edge transition is atomic within wrap() and cannot be skipped or manipulated.
steps: Review wrap() function flow for reward calculation
Verify IncentiveLib usage and floor rounding
Check no external input affects calculation path
Verify calculation is always executed on wrap
Test edge cases (zero amounts, max amounts)

executable_checks.description: Test reward calculation with various inputs
executable_checks.focus: Verify floor rounding and edge cases

checklist.notes: Internal transition - no external manipulation possible

checklist.title: Liquidity Pull Prerequisite Enforcement

detection_procedure.description: Verify that the liquidity pull edge requires successful transferFrom of underlying tokens - edge cannot be traversed without actual token transfer.
steps: Review transferFrom call in wrap flow
Verify revert on insufficient balance/allowance
Check no bypass of transferFrom call
Verify token address cannot be manipulated
Test with various ERC20 implementations

checklist.notes: ERC20 guarantees enforce collateralization - verify correct usage

checklist.title: Mint After Liquidity Pull Ordering

detection_procedure.description: Verify that zERC20 minting only occurs after successful liquidity pull - prevents unbacked token creation.
steps: Trace wrap() execution flow
Verify transferFrom precedes mint call
Check no path allows mint without transfer
Verify reentrancy cannot reorder operations
Test edge ordering with various scenarios

checklist.notes: Critical ordering - prevents unbacked minting

checklist.title: Wrap Completion Event Emission

detection_procedure.description: Verify that wrap completion emits Wrapped event atomically with state transition.
steps: Locate Wrapped event definition and emission
Verify event is emitted after successful mint
Check event parameters match actual wrap details
Verify atomicity with transaction
Test event capture in integration tests

checklist.notes: Event emission is verifiable via transaction logs
